universalAnswers.whatHappened: Microsoft and AFT signed September7; AFT/UFT/Microsoft announced school AI privacy terms September9.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: Covered education-designed generative AI creates text or other content from instructions.
universalAnswers.evidenceBasis: Signed agreement supplied captures, full Microsoft release and full AP article were read through September15.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: Bound commitments and independent reactions do not establish school implementation, correct answers or learning value.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: A parent or teacher needs to understand what terms cover a specific AI school assignment.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: US schools requesting these terms for primarily education-designed generative AI, their educators and families.
universalAnswers.changesNow: Schools can request incorporated contract protections; coverage is opt-in and excludes general-purpose products.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: Implementation, output correctness, learning results and other vendor agreements remain unproven.
universalAnswers.readerAction: Ask which exact product is assigned and whether the school incorporated these standards.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: Which product and school terms actually cover this assignment, and what establishes its learning value?

legal-policy.legalStatus: Signed contractual standard; US school districts may incorporate applicable protections into customer agreements.
legal-policy.jurisdiction: US educational entities licensing primarily education-designed generative AI; opt-in scope only.
legal-policy.parties: AFT National Academy and Microsoft signed; UFT participated in announcement; requesting US school customers incorporate terms.
legal-policy.allegationVsFinding: AP reports outside criticism and vendor negotiations; commitments do not establish implementation or learning outcomes.
legal-policy.currentEffect: Schools may request terms for covered products; no automatic all-school or all-product protection asserted.
legal-policy.unresolvedQuestions: Specific school implementation, output accuracy, educational appropriateness and other vendor signatures remain open.
legal-policy.nextMilestone: Publication-day source refresh and exact school agreement incorporation; no uncaptured November1 rollout claim.

translation.newsVersionExact: US school districts can incorporate the protections into their Microsoft agreements, making them contractually enforceable.
translation.actualMeaningExact: Schools must opt in, and the agreement covers primarily education-designed generative AI
translation.mechanismExact: That exception cannot feed general model improvement, advertising or unrelated commercial uses.
translation.familiarExampleExact: Imagine a child is assigned an AI tutor.
